description: This file defines Gradle build logic for Android app variants, including tasks for generating and checking app badging information, with classes GenerateBadgingTask and CheckBadgingTask, and a function to configure these tasks per variant.

classes.name: GenerateBadgingTask
classes.description: An abstract Gradle task for generating app badging information, producing a badging file by executing a command line tool.

classes.name: CheckBadgingTask
classes.description: An abstract Gradle task for verifying that generated badging matches a golden file, used for testing consistency.

methods.name: taskAction
methods.description: Executes the command to dump badging info from the APK and writes output to the badging file.

methods.name: taskAction
methods.description: Compares generated badging with the golden file and asserts equality.

methods.name: capitalized
methods.description: Extension function to capitalize the first character of a string.

methods.name: configureBadgingTasks
methods.description: Configures and registers badging-related tasks for each Android variant.
